title: Judges Who Are Fair
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler with the warm heart, and tonight a king asks his judges to be fair to everyone: Willow shares the orange slices evenly and gives the shy neighbor the first turn on the swing.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because Willow has a warm heart that notices who is left out, and tonight a king asks his judges to treat everyone the same. In Willow’s world today: Grandma asks Willow to share the orange slices at snack time. There is little brother, cousin Theo, and Mia, the shy girl from next door. Willow counts carefully so everyone gets four. Then Willow sees that Mia never gets a turn on the tire swing, so Willow gives Mia the first turn. Little brother frowns, so Willow hugs him and promises he is next. Just like King Jehoshaphat’s judges, Willow learned that being fair is a warm way to show love for God’s children.
